FREELANCE SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Freelance Services Agreement (this "Agreement") is entered into as of April 14, 2025, by and between Harbor & Finch Design Studio LLC, a Vermont limited liability company ("Client"), and Priya Ramanathan, an independent graphic designer doing business as Ramanathan Creative ("Designer"). Client and Designer are each a "Party" and together the "Parties."

BACKGROUND

Client wishes to engage Designer to create a brand identity package for Client's retail product line, and Designer wishes to provide those services on the terms set out below.

1. TERM

1.1 Fixed Term. This Agreement begins on the Effective Date and ends on August 14, 2025, unless the Parties agree in writing to extend it. This Agreement does not renew automatically; if the Parties want to continue working together after the end date, they will sign a new agreement or a written extension.

2. SCOPE OF SERVICES

2.1 Deliverables. Designer will deliver a logo, a brand style guide, and three packaging mockups, as described in Exhibit A.

2.2 Revisions. The fee in Section 3 includes up to two rounds of revisions per deliverable. Additional revision rounds beyond that allotment, or changes to the scope described in Exhibit A, will be billed at Designer's hourly rate of $95 and require Client's written approval before Designer begins the additional work.

3. FEES AND PAYMENT

3.1 Total Fee. Client will pay Designer a total fixed fee of $6,400 for the deliverables described in Exhibit A, payable in three installments: $2,000 upon signing, $2,000 upon delivery of initial concepts, and $2,400 upon final delivery. The fee does not change during the Term.

4. OWNERSHIP OF WORK

4.1 Assignment Upon Payment. Upon Client's payment in full for a given deliverable, Designer assigns to Client all right, title, and interest in that specific deliverable as described in Exhibit A.

4.2 Designer's Retained Materials. Designer retains ownership of pre-existing tools, fonts, design templates, and general design techniques used to create the deliverables, and may continue to use them in work for other clients. Nothing in this Agreement restricts Designer from taking on other clients, including clients in the same industry as Client.

5. CONFIDENTIALITY

5.1 Mutual Confidentiality. Each Party will keep the other Party's non-public business information confidential and will use it only as needed to perform this Agreement. This obligation continues for two years after the Term ends.

6. INDEMNIFICATION

6.1 Limited, Mutual Indemnification. Each Party will indemnify the other only for third-party claims that arise from that Party's own negligence, willful misconduct, or breach of this Agreement, and only to the extent a court determines that Party was at fault.

7. TERMINATION

7.1 Termination for Convenience. Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason by giving the other Party thirty (30) days' written notice.

7.2 Effect of Termination. If Client terminates before all deliverables are complete, Client will pay Designer for all work completed and any non-cancelable expenses Designer already incurred through the termination date. Neither Party owes the other any additional fee, penalty, or liquidated damages for terminating under this section.

8. DISPUTE RESOLUTION

8.1 Good-Faith Discussion; Court Available. If a dispute arises under this Agreement, the Parties will first attempt to resolve it through good-faith discussion. Either Party remains free to bring a claim in a court of competent jurisdiction at any time, and nothing in this Agreement requires either Party to arbitrate a dispute or waives either Party's right to participate in a class action.

9. GENERAL PROVISIONS

9.1 Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Vermont.

9.2 Independent Contractor. Designer is an independent contractor. Designer is not required to personally guarantee the obligations of any business entity, and no individual signing on behalf of a Party is personally liable for that Party's obligations under this Agreement beyond the entity's own assets.

9.3 Entire Agreement. This Agreement, including Exhibit A, is the entire agreement between the Parties regarding the deliverables described above.

9.4 Amendment. This Agreement may be amended only by a written document signed by both Parties.

9.5 Severability. If any provision of this Agreement is held unenforceable, the remaining provisions remain in full force and effect.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties have executed this Agreement as of the Effective Date.

EXHIBIT A: DELIVERABLES

1. Primary logo and secondary mark, delivered as vector files.
2. Brand style guide covering color palette, typography, and usage rules.
3. Three packaging mockups for the initial retail product line.
